'''Moia''' is one of the bosses in [[The Fractured Archive]]. She is the half-human, half-[[mahjarrat]] daughter of [[Lucien]]. During a given raid of The Fractured Archive, players can choose to fight either Moia or [[Dreadnoth the Jellied]] as the third boss encounter.
